# serverguard24 Provider

Provider for managing Serverguard24 monitoring resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "serverguard24" {
  # Set via SG24_API_TOKEN environment variable, or:
  # api_token = var.serverguard24_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Serverguard24 API token. Can also be set via the `SG24_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
